title: Gisèle Pelicot to attend appeals court as man convicted of raping her contests verdict
summary: Husamettin Dogan, 44, was sentenced to nine years in prison at trial of 51 men last year where all were found guilty Gisèle Pelicot, who survived almost a decade of rape involving dozens of men after she was drugged by her ex-husband, will attend court in France again on Monday after one of the men convicted of raping her faces a second trial after appealing against his verdict. Pelicot became a feminist hero after she decided to waive her right to anonymity in the 2024 trial of her former husband and 50 other men last year. Continue reading...
